summary: This is a Docker Compose configuration file that sets up LimeSurvey (a survey application) with two services: a web application container and a MySQL database container. The app container connects to the database, exposes a web port, and waits for the database to be healthy before starting. Several configuration values are templated with %% markers, likely to be replaced by a deployment tool.

explanations.6: This creates a unique container name using a template variable that will be replaced later—it prevents naming conflicts if you run multiple instances.
explanations.7: This tells Docker to automatically restart the container if it crashes or stops, keeping the service available.
explanations.10: This points the app to the database using another template variable for the database container's name, so they can communicate.
explanations.19: This maps port 8080 on your host machine to port 8080 inside the container, so you can access the survey app from your browser.
explanations.21: This makes the app wait until the database container is healthy (passes its health check) before trying to start, preventing connection errors.
explanations.33: This health check command runs inside the database container every few seconds to verify MySQL is responding; if it fails repeatedly, Docker marks the service as unhealthy.
